title: Exploring the Role of Location-Based Games in Managing Tourist Destinations Under Climate Change Challenges: A Gap Analysis Review
authors: Omid Mansourihanis; Moein Hemmati; Sepehr Vaez Afshar; Sarvin Eshaghi; Güzden Varinlioğlu
summary: A review of 75 studies examining location-based games and climate resilience in tourism, identifying research gaps and directions for participatory adaptation.
